notes:
A big one — ratings you can actually see, a personal Watch Next, private
collections, a proper Cartoons section, and polish all over.

- **Rate and start a room right from the title.** The **Rate** and **Start a
  room** buttons now sit on the main action bar next to Play, Mark watched and
  Add to collection — and once you've rated something, the Rate button shows
  **your own score** right there.

- **See everyone's scores before you rate.** Community ratings used to appear
  only after you'd rated a title yourself. Now the average and vote count show up
  whether or not you've rated it.

- **Watch Next — your own personal list.** Right-click *Add to collection* and
  you'll always find **Watch Next**: a private list only you can see. Anything
  you line up there shows under **Continue Watching**, ready to go.

- **Private collections.** Making or managing a collection now has a **Private —
  only you can see it** switch, so you can keep personal collections to yourself.

- **A title can live in several collections.** The old one-collection limit is
  gone — add a show or movie to as many collections as you like.

- **Collections, more polished.** Give a brand-new collection a **description and
  poster** right when you create it in Add media → Advanced options. The chosen
  collection no longer sticks to your next, unrelated download, and a collection
  you just made shows up in the list without restarting the app. Only a
  collection's creator (or the admin) can edit it.

- **Cartoons, done properly.** Cartoons are now their own **episodic** section
  with seasons and episodes, named **Cartoons** everywhere, with their own icon
  and a spot in the library list and every type menu.

- **Filter by age rating.** Library sections with age-rating info (like Cartoons)
  get an **age filter** next to the genre filter.

- **Find something to watch — better.** Clearer name, and it works right away
  instead of asking you to rate things first. Pick several genres and choose
  whether a pick should match **any** of them or **all** of them.

- **Release notes, in the app.** Settings now has a **Release notes** section so
  you can see what changed, right here.

- **Refresh, front and centre.** The refresh button moved up top next to the
  **Unseen** wordmark, in the app's yellow.

- **Smaller touches.** Adding something already in your library is flagged as you
  type it, and **Start over** now explains itself when you hover.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
